name: covenant-public
description: Find published services, draft a small job with a price and deadline, compare changes and check supplied records. Nine public tools.

interface.longDescription: For a small job, find published service adverts and draft the deliverable, price, deadline and delivery review. Compare revisions before anyone approves. Make a readable copy of the exact draft, then check what the supplied approvals and evidence establish or leave unknown. These nine public tools need no account. Drafts remain unsigned: this plugin does not sign, publish adverts, create private account records, place an order or move money. Search results can include labelled demos; confirm real availability with the supplier. Supplied records are checked only within the stated verification scope. The hosted service is a developer pilot. Private account features and the separately licensed engine are outside this plugin.
capabilities: Draft a job, price and deadline
defaultPrompt: Find published research services and label any demos. Tell me if there is no matching supplier.
Draft a one-page research brief for USD 25, due Friday, with buyer review. Keep it unsigned.
Compare these two drafts: show the price and deadline changes and what needs fresh approval.

review.commerce_description: Public service-advert discovery and unsigned proposal preparation only. This plugin does not perform checkout, create orders with assent, collect fees, execute payments or provide financial trading. Paid account features are excluded.

positive.description: Find current public services without presenting demos as real suppliers
positive.prompt: Search the Covenant marketplace. Tell me which returned listings are demos, and do not invent a supplier when nothing matches. Do not sign, publish or pay.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only current INDEXED public records. Preserve demo_only labels and do not claim that provider identity, stock, performance or payment is verified. A search for the deliberately unpublished fixture returns no matching inventory.

positive.description: Prepare an unsigned USD25 service agreement
positive.prompt: Draft an agreement for one research brief costing USD 25, with a delivery review. Show a simple trade as an alternative. Keep everything unsigned and do not publish or pay.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the draft with its exact identifier, UNSIGNED_DRAFT and binding=false. Represent the simple trade as 2500 USD cents without converting units silently. Require explicit buyer and seller assent and authorize no execution.

positive.description: Make the USD25 to USD30 change explicit
positive.prompt: Compare these exact unsigned versions after changing the price from USD 25 to USD 30. Show what changed and explain whether the old approval can cover the new version. Do not sign either version.
positive.expected_behavior: Return distinct before and after identifiers. Show the price change within the clauses. Set requires_fresh_assent=true and execution_authorized=false.

positive.description: Inspect and read the same exact draft
positive.prompt: Inspect this exact research-brief draft and make a readable copy. Keep its identifier and unsigned status visible; do not treat the display as a signed contract.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspection returns the original draft identifier and unsigned status. The HTML copy contains that identifier, the terms and the unsigned label. No signing or execution occurs.

positive.description: Review what is known without inventing assent, authority or proof
positive.prompt: Review this case containing only a reference to my unsigned draft. Explain which agreement, authority and evidence claims are still unverified. Do not convert a draft into an accepted agreement or infer any payment.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the draft as DECLARED_REFERENCE_ONLY with NOT_VERIFIED assent. Mark supplied role names as caller-declared, with no controller/payment authority. Report NO_PROOFS_PROVIDED and zero verified proofs. Keep execution_authorized=false, recorded=false and signature_created=false.

negative.description: Reject a draft supplied where a review case is required
negative.prompt: Try reviewing an unsigned draft wrapper directly as a case. It should not be reported as a verified agreement.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the draft wrapper as the wrong input for coordination-case review. Return a precise, correctable case-format error, or explain the required case format and ask for it before calling. Do not report a successful review, verified agreement, assent or authority.

negative.description: Reject a mismatching exact case identifier
negative.prompt: Review this supplied case against a different expected identifier. Do not silently adopt the supplied bytes as the expected case.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the mismatching expected case identifier with a precise input error. Explain that the supplied case bytes do not match the requested identifier and require the correct case or expected identifier. Do not substitute the supplied identifier, report successful review or infer fresh approval.

negative.description: Reject a malformed direct authority identity
negative.prompt: Inspect a claimed agreement role containing an invalid public-key string. Do not treat it as verified signing or payment authority.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the malformed direct Ed25519 public key with a precise, correctable identity-format error, or ask for a correctly formatted public key before calling. Do not treat the role as verified identity, signing permission or payment authority.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.1: clearer service-search, job-drafting and revision prompts; five positive and three negative reviewer cases with explicit safe expected results. Nine anonymous hosted tools and the free public scope are unchanged. Reviewer expectations are separate from retained observations. No review video is declared without an actual recording URL. No private implementation source, account endpoint, credentials, executable hooks, signing or payment tools are bundled.
